source.data: hreflang links in the held snapshots of www.lufthansa-cargo.com (server HTML), 7 languages and x-default per page; no sitemap read

pairing: partly measured, nothing moves: the held snapshots are 67 pages (en and de) that name 62 sets of alternates; 57 sets have one slug in every language and 5 have a German slug that differs from the English one (listed as candidates). That is a sample (articles alone are 389 en and 348 de); no group is listed and no flag exists until the pairing of all pages is measured.
